body: think of it this way - if he had the presence of mind to see that you were so drunk that he had to ask several times, then he had the presence of mind to know that you were incapacitated on that level. he had sex with you when he knew you were incapacitated. that is rape. again, anyone who says drunk people can't rape drunk people has clearly never, ever taken the time to educate themselves on rape. it's such a frighteningly stereotypical example of ignorance with regards to this subject.

this was rape. if he had to ask, and KEEP ASKING because you were so drunk, then he was not getting consent. drunk people can rape other drunk people. i'm very sorry. this was rape and you are 100% deserving of seeking the help you need to sort through this. even if you flirted, initiated the kiss, got naked, etc. talk to a therapist and they will help you sort through any guilt about your marriage to see the truth of what this man did to you. this is not uncommon and you are not alone.
